body: High battery use if generally indicative of a hungrier GPS chip on your device. You can lower the accuracy in your device's settings to reduce usage - additionally location over wifi when you are at home (although, this will cause location accuracy issues).

author: Gehrkenator22
body:
Based on reading other comments, it really seems like your issue isn't with the game so much as poor battery health. Only time I ever had battery issues while playing orna was when I had a lot of background stuff running. All of that stopped when I disabled background processes on all non-essential systems and applications. I've run orna for 18hrs a day in the past without charging my phone and still have 40-50% battery left over.

To summarize: have better battery hygiene.

(If you do the above already, then your battery is probably the issue, and you should just replace it)

author: petr1petr
body:
I have not noticed that it would drain battery more than other games I play - now, in summer, I tend to have more brightness - on all games, so again, no difference.

GPS game with GPS turned off - yeah, so that you can stay on place with 10 dungeons, go home and finish it there? for real? Actually, if I were dev, I would have the game forced closed when GPS is not detected. People are abusing this. and it is wrong.
